title: hello survey — a genuine reading of the checked-out repo + an MR greeting

ok.description: CHECKABLE — the survey ran to completion.

repo_files.description: CHECKABLE — how many tracked files the checked-out repo has (git ls-files).

sample.description: CHECKABLE — a few real paths the survey saw, proving it read the actual tree.

sha.description: The commit the node checked out (proves the checkout landed).

commented.description: CHECKABLE — whether the survey posted its greeting to the MR through the forge API.

comment_url.description: URL of the posted comment, when commented; not checked.

comment_error.description: Diagnostic when the comment did not post; not checked.
